<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html b:version='2' class='v2' expr:dir='data:blog.languageDirection' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml' xmlns:b='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/b' xmlns:data='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/data' xmlns:expr='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/expr'>
<head>
<meta content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover' name='viewport'/>
<meta content='#07060f' name='theme-color'/>
<title><data:blog.pageTitle/></title>
<link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com' rel='preconnect'/>
<link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;family=Poppins:wght@500;600;700;800&amp;display=swap' rel='stylesheet'/>
<b:include data='blog' name='all-head-content'/>
<link href='data:image/png;base64,' rel='icon' type='image/png'/>
<link href='data:image/png;base64,' rel='apple-touch-icon'/>
<b:skin version='1.0.0'><![CDATA[
:root{--bg:#07060f;--bg2:#0e0c1d;--card:#13112a;--card2:#1b1838;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--tx:#f4f2ff;--mu:#a9a5c8;--p:#8b5cf6;--p2:#d946ef;--gold:#fbbf24;--ok:#22c55e;--bad:#f43f5e;--r:20px}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Hind Siliguri','Poppins',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);line-height:1.55;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;font-size:16px}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(900px 500px at 8% -5%,rgba(139,92,246,.22),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(800px 500px at 100% 10%,rgba(217,70,239,.14),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(700px 500px at 50% 110%,rgba(251,191,36,.08),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/44px 44px,linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/44px 44px}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px}
.nb{display:none}
#navbar,.navbar{display:none!important}
body:not(.pg-index) #app{display:none}
.bp{max-width:820px;margin:40px auto;padding:20px}
.bp-a h1{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:16px}
.bp-body{color:#d9d6f0;line-height:1.9}
.bp-back{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:20px;color:var(--gold)}
/* announce */
#ann{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8b5cf6,#c084fc,#d946ef);text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;padding:9px 14px;color:#fff}
#ann a{opacity:.95;margin-left:10px;text-decoration:underline}
/* header */
header.hd{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(10,8,22,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:12px 0}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:20px;white-space:nowrap}
.logo i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(139,92,246,.45);font-size:19px}
.logo img{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover}
.sr{flex:1;max-width:520px;position:relative}
.sr input{width:100%;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:11px 44px 11px 16px;outline:0;transition:.2s}
.sr input:focus{border-color:var(--p);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(139,92,246,.18)}
.sr button{position:absolute;right:6px;top:5px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2))}
.hr{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:13px;font-weight:600;transition:.2s;white-space:nowrap}
.b1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(139,92,246,.4)}
.b1:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.b2{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.b2:hover{border-color:var(--p)}
.b3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fde68a,#fbbf24);color:#2b1a00;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(251,191,36,.3)}
.cartb{position:relative;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:19px}
.cartb em{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;min-width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--gold);color:#241500;font:700 12px/20px Poppins,sans-serif;text-align:center;font-style:normal;padding:0 5px}
.me{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:5px 14px 5px 5px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:30px}
.me b{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));display:grid;place-items:center}
.me span{font-size:13px;line-height:1.2}.me small{color:var(--gold);display:block;font-size:12px}
nav#nav{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:auto;padding:0 0 12px;scrollbar-width:none}
nav#nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
nav#nav a{white-space:nowrap;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:30px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:500;font-size:15px;transition:.2s}
nav#nav a:hover{border-color:var(--p)}
nav#nav a.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
/* hero */
#hero{position:relative;margin:26px 0;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 30px 80px -20px rgba(139,92,246,.45)}
.htrack{display:flex;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1)}
.slide{min-width:100%;position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:54px 70px;min-height:330px;background:radial-gradient(500px 300px at 85% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(120deg,var(--c1),var(--c2))}
.slide:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px,transparent 1.5px) 0 0/22px 22px;opacity:.35;pointer-events:none}
.hl{position:relative;z-index:2}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin-bottom:16px}
.badge i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac)}
.hl h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4.2vw,50px);line-height:1.2;font-weight:700}
.hl h1 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ac),#f472b6);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hl p{margin:14px 0 22px;color:#e6e0ff;opacity:.88;font-size:17px}
.cta{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fde68a,var(--ac));color:#2a1800;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:.2s}
.cta:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.hv{position:relative;height:290px}
.gl{position:absolute;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);padding:10px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35);animation:fl 6s ease-in-out infinite;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.gl img{width:100%;flex:1;min-height:0;object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px;background:#0003}
.gl span{font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-weight:600}
.gl b{font:700 13px Poppins,'Hind Siliguri';color:var(--ac)}
.g1{width:230px;height:250px;left:28%;top:20px;z-index:2}
.g2{width:150px;height:170px;left:0;top:8px;animation-delay:-2s}
.g3{width:150px;height:170px;right:2%;bottom:0;z-index:3;animation-delay:-4s}
.bolt{position:absolute;right:6%;top:-6px;font-size:44px;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 14px rgba(244,114,182,.6));animation:fl 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
.har{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);color:#2a1860;font-size:18px;z-index:5;font-weight:700}
.har.l{left:14px}.har.r{right:14px}
.dots{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:16px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:7px;z-index:5}
.dots i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.4);cursor:pointer;transition:.3s}
.dots i.on{width:26px;background:var(--gold)}
.hc{position:absolute;right:26px;bottom:14px;font:600 13px Poppins;color:#ffffffb0;z-index:5}
/* sections */
.sec{margin:38px 0}
.sh{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px}
.sh h2{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.sh h2:before{content:"";width:6px;height:26px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(var(--p),var(--p2))}
.sh a,.sh select{color:var(--mu);font-size:14px}
.sh select{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 10px}
.tag{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:6px 15px;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.5);background:rgba(139,92,246,.12);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px}
.tag i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--ok)}
.cats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px}
.cat{padding:20px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card2),var(--card));border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;transition:.25s;font-weight:600}
.cat:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--p)}
.cat i{font-style:normal;font-size:30px;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(139,92,246,.16);display:grid;place-items:center}
.strip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:20px;color:#fff;margin:14px 0;box-shadow:0 14px 34px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.45);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);transition:.25s}
a.strip:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.strip .si{font-style:normal;font-size:30px;flex:none}
.strip .stx{flex:1;min-width:0}
.strip .s1{font-weight:600;font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
.strip .s1 b{color:#fde68a;font-weight:700}
.strip .pl{display:inline-block;background:#fff;color:var(--tc);padding:0 10px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;margin:0 2px}
.strip .s2{font-size:12.5px;opacity:.92;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.4}
.strip .sbtn{flex:none;background:#fff;color:var(--tc);padding:9px 20px;border-radius:30px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
@media(max-width:600px){.strip{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 14px;gap:10px}.strip .si{font-size:24px}.strip .s1{font-size:14px}.strip .sbtn{margin-left:auto;padding:7px 16px;font-size:13px}}
/* promo banners */
.pbs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,320px),1fr));gap:18px}
.pb{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:26px;padding:28px 30px;min-height:190px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);transition:.3s}
.pb:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.01)}
.pb:before,.pb:after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.pb:before{width:260px;height:260px;right:-70px;top:-90px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.pb:after{width:160px;height:160px;left:-50px;bottom:-70px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.pb>*{position:relative;z-index:2}
.pb small{display:inline-block;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.3px}
.pb h3{font-size:22px;line-height:1.25}
.pb p{opacity:.9;font-size:14px;margin-top:4px}
.pb .big{font:800 44px/1.05 'Hind Siliguri',Poppins;margin:6px 0;text-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.pb .cd{font:600 13px Poppins,'Hind Siliguri';background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);display:inline-block;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:10px;margin:4px 0 10px}
.pb .go{display:inline-block;margin-top:6px;padding:9px 20px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#1b1030;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.pb img{width:150px;height:150px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:22px;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);transform:rotate(6deg);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);flex:none}
.s-flash{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ff3d6e,#ff7a18)}
.s-mega{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#4338ca,#0ea5e9);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0 14px,transparent 14px 28px),linear-gradient(120deg,#4338ca,#0ea5e9)}
.s-neon{background:#0b0818;border:2px solid #22d3ee;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(34,211,238,.35),inset 0 0 40px rgba(217,70,239,.25)}
.s-neon .big{color:#22d3ee;text-shadow:0 0 22px #22d3ee}
.s-sunset{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#f97316,#ec4899 55%,#8b5cf6)}
.s-mint{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#059669,#65a30d)}
/* products */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:18px}
.pc{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--card2),var(--card));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:.3s}
.pc:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.7);box-shadow:0 24px 50px -16px rgba(139,92,246,.5)}
.pc-i{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;overflow:hidden;background:#0004;display:block}
.pc-i img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.5s}
.pc:hover .pc-i img{transform:scale(1.08)}
.off{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f43f5e,#fb923c);color:#fff;font:700 12px Poppins,'Hind Siliguri';padding:4px 10px;border-radius:10px}
.sold{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700}
.pc-b{padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.pc-b small{color:var(--mu);font-size:12px}
.pc-b h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:600;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;min-height:43px}
.pr{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-top:auto}
.pr b{font:700 19px Poppins,'Hind Siliguri';color:var(--gold)}
.pr s{color:var(--mu);font-size:13px}
.pc-act{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;align-items:stretch;margin-top:8px}
.det{display:block;min-width:0;text-align:center;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(139,92,246,.32);transition:.2s}
.det:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.add{align-self:center;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(139,92,246,.14);border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.45);font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap;transition:.2s}
.add:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));border-color:transparent}
.add:disabled{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:70px 20px;color:var(--mu);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:22px;font-size:18px}
/* product page */
.pd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:34px;margin:30px auto}
.gm{border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:1/1}
.gm img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.gt{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.gt button{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid var(--line);opacity:.65}
.gt button.on{border-color:var(--gold);opacity:1}
.gt img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.pi h1{font-size:30px;line-height:1.3}
.pi .pp{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
.pi .pp b{font:700 34px Poppins,'Hind Siliguri';color:var(--gold)}
.pi .pp s{color:var(--mu)}
.pi .ds{color:#d3cfee;line-height:1.85;margin:16px 0;white-space:pre-line}
.qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden}
.qty button{width:38px;height:40px;font-size:20px}.qty button:hover{background:var(--card2)}
.qty span{min-width:38px;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
.acts{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}
.ref{padding:16px;border-radius:18px;border:1px dashed rgba(251,191,36,.6);background:rgba(251,191,36,.07);margin-top:14px;font-size:15px}
.ref b{color:var(--gold)}
.ref input{width:100%;margin-top:10px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px}
/* drawer */
#scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s;z-index:90}
#scrim.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
#drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100%;width:min(430px,100%);background:var(--bg2);border-left:1px solid var(--line);z-index:100;transform:translateX(105%);transition:.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#drawer.on{transform:none}
.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:18px}
.dh button{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--card)}
#dbody{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:14px 18px}
#dfoot{padding:16px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card)}
.ci{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ci img{width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:14px;object-fit:cover}
.ci div{flex:1;font-size:14px}.ci b{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:4px}
.ci .qty button{width:30px;height:32px}.ci .qty span{min-width:28px}
.ci .rm{color:var(--bad);font-size:13px;margin-left:10px}
.prog{height:9px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--card2);overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0 12px}
.prog i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--p),var(--gold));border-radius:6px;transition:.5s}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:6px 0}
.row.t{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:10px;margin-top:10px}
/* forms/checkout */
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:26px;margin:30px auto}
.box{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--card2),var(--card));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:24px}
.box h2{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:16px}
.fl{display:block;margin-bottom:14px}.fl span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:6px}
.fl input,.fl textarea,.fl select{width:100%;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:12px 14px;outline:0;transition:.2s}
.fl input:focus,.fl textarea:focus{border-color:var(--p);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(139,92,246,.17)}
.chk{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(251,191,36,.08);border:1px dashed rgba(251,191,36,.5);margin-bottom:12px}
.chk input{width:auto}
.st{display:inline-block;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.st-pending{background:#f59e0b33;color:#fbbf24}.st-confirmed{background:#3b82f633;color:#60a5fa}.st-shipped{background:#a855f733;color:#d8b4fe}.st-delivered{background:#22c55e33;color:#4ade80}.st-cancelled{background:#f43f5e33;color:#fda4af}
.ord{padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--bg2)}
.ord .oh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.stat{padding:18px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(139,92,246,.28),rgba(217,70,239,.12));border:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat small{color:var(--mu)}.stat b{display:block;font:700 26px Poppins,'Hind Siliguri';margin-top:4px}
/* auth */
.auth{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;min-height:640px;margin:26px 0;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 40px 100px -30px rgba(139,92,246,.6)}
.auth-l{position:relative;padding:48px 44px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#1b1140,#3b1d8f 55%,#7c2bb8);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.auth-l:before,.auth-l:after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(60px)}
.auth-l:before{width:340px;height:340px;background:#d946ef66;right:-90px;top:-80px}
.auth-l:after{width:300px;height:300px;background:#fbbf2444;left:-80px;bottom:-90px}
.auth-l>*{position:relative;z-index:2}
.auth-l h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);line-height:1.25;margin:20px 0 12px}
.auth-l h2 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fde68a,#f472b6);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.auth-l>p{color:#e0d9ff;opacity:.85;margin-bottom:22px}
.perks{display:grid;gap:12px}
.perk{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:13px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.perk i{font-style:normal;font-size:24px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);display:grid;place-items:center}
.perk b{display:block}.perk span{font-size:13px;opacity:.8}
.auth-r{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:34px 24px}
.acard{width:100%;max-width:410px}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;padding:6px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:24px}
.seg button{padding:12px;border-radius:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mu);transition:.25s}
.seg button.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(139,92,246,.45)}
.acard h3{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:4px}.acard>p{color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:20px}
.ip{position:relative;margin-bottom:14px}
.ip i{position:absolute;left:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-style:normal;opacity:.8}
.ip input{width:100%;padding:14px 44px 14px 44px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);outline:0;transition:.2s}
.ip input:focus{border-color:var(--p);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(139,92,246,.2)}
.ip .eye{position:absolute;right:8px;left:auto;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 8px}
.err{color:#fda4af;font-size:14px;min-height:20px;margin-bottom:8px}
.acard .b1{width:100%;padding:14px;font-size:17px}
.sw{text-align:center;margin-top:16px;color:var(--mu);font-size:14px}.sw a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
/* footer */
footer{margin-top:60px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);padding:36px 0 90px}
.fg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr;gap:28px;color:var(--mu);font-size:15px}
.fg h4{color:var(--tx);margin-bottom:10px}.fg a{display:block;margin:6px 0}.fg a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
/* chat */
#chatb{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:70;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));font-size:26px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(139,92,246,.6);animation:pu 2.5s infinite}
@keyframes pu{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(139,92,246,0)}}
#chat{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:90px;z-index:80;width:min(370px,calc(100% - 24px));height:480px;max-height:70vh;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;display:none;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#chat.on{display:flex}
.ch{padding:16px 18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.ch small{display:block;opacity:.85;font-size:12px}
#cm{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.m{max-width:80%;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:16px;font-size:14px;word-break:break-word}
.m.u{align-self:flex-end;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
.m.a{align-self:flex-start;background:var(--card2);border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
#cf{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
#cf input{flex:1;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:10px 14px;outline:0}
#cf button{width:44px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2))}
/* popups */
#pop{position:fixed;left:16px;bottom:18px;z-index:75;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;max-width:340px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(20,17,42,.94);border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5);transform:translateY(40px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2),opacity .4s,visibility 0s .5s;font-size:14px}
#pop.on{transform:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2),opacity .4s,visibility 0s}
#pop i{font-style:normal;font-size:26px;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
#pop small{color:var(--mu);display:block}
#pop b{color:var(--gold)}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:84px;transform:translate(-50%,-30px);opacity:0;z-index:200;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--p);transition:.4s;pointer-events:none;font-weight:600}
#toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
#wel{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;background:rgba(5,4,14,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:none;place-items:center}
#wel.on{display:grid}
#wel div{text-align:center;padding:44px 50px;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#2a1668,#6d28d9 70%,#a21caf);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);animation:pp .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1);max-width:90%}
#wel h2{font-size:34px;margin:8px 0}#wel p{opacity:.9}
@keyframes pp{from{transform:scale(.6);opacity:0}}
#bnav{display:none}
@media(max-width:860px){
body{padding-bottom:70px}
.wrap{padding:0 12px}
.hrow{gap:10px;padding:10px 0}.logo{font-size:17px}.logo i,.logo img{width:34px;height:34px}
.hr{gap:6px}.hr .btn{padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px}.cartb{display:none}
.sr input{padding:10px 44px 10px 14px}
#hero{margin:14px 0;border-radius:22px}
.hl h1{font-size:26px}.hl p{font-size:15px;margin:10px 0 16px}
.cta{padding:11px 20px}
.sh h2{font-size:21px}.cats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.cat{padding:14px;gap:10px}.cat i{width:44px;height:44px;font-size:24px}
.pc-b{padding:10px}.pc-b h3{font-size:14px;min-height:38px}.pr b{font-size:16px}.pc-act{gap:6px}.det{padding:9px;font-size:13px}
.pi h1{font-size:23px}.pi .pp b{font-size:28px}.acts .btn{flex:1}
.pd,.two{gap:18px;margin:16px auto}.box{padding:18px}
.auth{border-radius:22px;margin:12px 0;min-height:0}.auth-r{padding:24px 16px}.auth-l h2{margin:12px 0 8px}
.pb{padding:20px;min-height:0}.pb h3{font-size:19px}
footer{padding-bottom:110px}
#chatb{display:none}
#chat{right:8px;left:8px;width:auto;bottom:78px;height:70vh}
#pop{left:10px;right:10px;bottom:78px;max-width:none}
#toast{top:70px;max-width:90%;text-align:center}
#drawer{width:100%}
#bnav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:60;background:rgba(12,10,28,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 4px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
#bnav a,#bnav button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;font-size:11px;color:var(--mu);position:relative;padding:4px 0}
#bnav i{font-style:normal;font-size:20px}
#bnav a.on{color:var(--gold)}
#bnav em{position:absolute;top:0;left:55%;min-width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--gold);color:#241500;font:700 10px/17px Poppins;text-align:center;font-style:normal}
}
@media(max-width:860px){
.slide{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:34px 22px 56px;gap:6px}
.hv{height:230px;order:-1}.g1{width:170px;height:190px;left:30%}.g2,.g3{width:112px;height:130px}
.har{display:none}
.pd,.two,.auth,.fg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.auth-l{padding:30px 24px}.auth-l .perks{display:none}
.sr{order:5;flex-basis:100%;max-width:none}.hrow{flex-wrap:wrap}
.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}
.pbs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pb img{width:100px;height:100px}.pb .big{font-size:34px}
.me span{display:none}.me{padding:5px}
}

/* ===== v2: wishlist, badges, trust, flash, timeline, skeleton, social ===== */
.pc{position:relative}
.heart{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:4;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(10,8,22,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);font-size:18px;line-height:1;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.25s}
.heart:hover{transform:scale(1.12)}
.heart.on{background:rgba(244,63,94,.28);border-color:#f43f5e;animation:hb .4s}
@keyframes hb{50%{transform:scale(1.3)}}
.bdgs{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:flex-start}
.bdgs .off{position:static}
.bdg{font:700 12px 'Hind Siliguri',Poppins;color:#fff;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.bdg.nw{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#06b6d4)}
.bdg.lw{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#ef4444);animation:lw 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes lw{50%{transform:scale(1.06)}}
.hbtn.on{border-color:#f43f5e;color:#fda4af}
.trust{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin:0 0 8px}
.trs{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card2),var(--card));border:1px solid var(--line);transition:.25s}
.trs:hover{border-color:var(--p);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.trs i{font-style:normal;font-size:26px;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:15px;background:rgba(139,92,246,.16);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.trs b{display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3}
.trs span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.35}
.flash.on{border-radius:28px;padding:20px 18px 6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(244,63,94,.22),rgba(251,146,60,.12) 60%,rgba(139,92,246,.12));border:1px solid rgba(244,63,94,.4);box-shadow:0 20px 60px -24px rgba(244,63,94,.5)}
.fh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.fh h2{font-size:26px;font-weight:700}
.fcd{font:700 15px Poppins,'Hind Siliguri';background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f43f5e,#fb923c);padding:7px 16px;border-radius:30px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(244,63,94,.4)}
.hs{display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 2px 16px;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(139,92,246,.5) transparent;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.hs .pc{flex:0 0 210px;scroll-snap-align:start}
.tl{display:flex;margin:14px 0 10px}
.tls{flex:1;text-align:center;position:relative;font-size:12px;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.3}
.tls:not(:first-child):before{content:"";position:absolute;top:15px;right:50%;width:100%;height:3px;background:var(--line);border-radius:2px}
.tls.done:not(:first-child):before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--p),var(--p2))}
.tls i{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;margin:0 auto 6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card2);border:2px solid var(--line);font-style:normal;font-size:15px;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.55}
.tls.done i{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));border-color:transparent;filter:none;opacity:1}
.tls.cur i{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(139,92,246,.28)}
.tls.done{color:var(--tx);font-weight:600}
.tlx{margin:10px 0;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#f43f5e22;color:#fda4af;font-size:14px}
.share{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px;color:var(--mu);font-size:14px}
.sh-b{padding:7px 14px;border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--tx)}
.sh-b.wa{background:#16a34a22;border-color:#16a34a;color:#4ade80}
.sh-b.fb{background:#1877f222;border-color:#1877f2;color:#7db4ff}
.skh,.skc .a,.skc .b{background-color:transparent;background-image:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.14) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 70%);background-size:200% 100%;animation:shm 1.4s linear infinite}
@keyframes shm{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.skh{height:330px}
.skc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden}
.skc .a{aspect-ratio:1/1}
.skc .b{height:14px;margin:14px;border-radius:8px}
.fg .soc{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fg .soc a{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;margin:0;border-radius:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid var(--line);color:#fff;transition:.25s}
.fg .soc a:hover{background:var(--c);border-color:transparent;transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px -8px var(--c);color:#fff}
.fbot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mu);font-size:13px}
.pay{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pay span{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--c);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.pay small{margin-right:2px}
@media(max-width:860px){
.trust{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.trs{padding:10px;gap:9px;border-radius:16px}.trs i{width:38px;height:38px;font-size:20px;border-radius:12px}.trs b{font-size:13px}.trs span{font-size:11px}
.hs .pc{flex-basis:168px}
.flash.on{padding:14px 10px 2px;border-radius:22px}.fh h2{font-size:20px}.fcd{font-size:13px;padding:5px 12px}
.skh{height:300px}
.heart{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:16px;top:8px;right:8px}
.bdgs{top:8px;left:8px}.bdg{font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px}
.tls{font-size:10.5px}.tls i{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:13px}.tls:not(:first-child):before{top:13px}
.fbot{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
}
]]></b:skin>
</head>
<body expr:class='"pg-" + data:blog.pageType'>

<div id='app'>
<div id='ann'></div>
<header class='hd'><div class='wrap'>
<div class='hrow'>
<a class='logo' href='#/'><img class='lgimg' id='lgi' alt=''/><span id='lgt'>আমার শপ</span></a>
<form class='sr' id='sf'><input id='sq' placeholder='প্রডাক্ট খুঁজুন…' autocomplete='off'/><button type='submit'>🔍</button></form>
<div class='hr'>
<div id='who'></div>
<button class='cartb' id='cb' aria-label='cart'>🛒<em id='cn'>0</em></button>
</div></div>
<nav id='nav'></nav>
</div></header>
<main class='wrap' id='view'></main>
<footer><div class='wrap'><div class='fg'>
<div><div class='logo' style='margin-bottom:10px;color:#fff'><img class='lgimg' alt=''/><span id='fnm'>আমার শপ</span></div><p id='ftg'>সেরা পণ্য, সেরা দামে, দ্রুত ডেলিভারি।</p><div class='soc' id='soc'></div></div>
<div><h4>লিংক</h4><a href='#/'>হোম</a><a href='#/account'>আমার অ্যাকাউন্ট</a><a href='#/login'>লগইন</a></div>
<div><h4>যোগাযোগ</h4><a id='fph' href='#'></a><a id='fwa' href='#' target='_blank' rel='noopener'></a><span id='fad'></span></div>
</div><div class='fbot'><div class='pay' id='fpay'></div><small id='fcp'></small></div></div></footer>

<div id='scrim'></div>
<aside id='drawer'><div class='dh'><b>🛒 আপনার কার্ট</b><button id='dx'>✕</button></div><div id='dbody'></div><div id='dfoot'></div></aside>

<nav id='bnav'><a href='#/' data-b='home'><i>🏠</i>হোম</a><button id='bcat'><i>🗂️</i>ক্যাটাগরি</button><button id='bcart'><i>🛒</i>কার্ট<em id='bcn'>0</em></button><a href='#/account' data-b='account'><i>👤</i>অ্যাকাউন্ট</a><button id='bchat'><i>💬</i>চ্যাট</button></nav>
<button id='chatb' aria-label='chat'>💬</button>
<div id='chat'><div class='ch'><div><b>💬 লাইভ চ্যাট</b><small>আমরা সাহায্য করতে প্রস্তুত</small></div><button id='chx'>✕</button></div><div id='cm'></div><form id='cf'><input id='ci' placeholder='মেসেজ লিখুন…' autocomplete='off'/><button>➤</button></form></div>
<div id='pop'><i>🛍️</i><div id='popt'></div></div>
<div id='toast'></div>
<div id='wel'><div><div style='font-size:56px'>🎉</div><h2 id='welh'></h2><p id='welp'></p></div></div>
</div>

<b:section class='main' id='main' showaddelement='no'>
<b:widget id='Blog1' locked='true' title='Blog Posts' type='Blog' version='2'>
<b:includable id='main' var='this'>
<b:if cond='data:blog.pageType != "index"'>
<div class='bp'>
<a class='bp-back' expr:href='data:blog.homepageUrl'>← হোমে ফিরুন</a>
<b:loop values='data:posts' var='post'>
<article class='bp-a'><h1><data:post.title/></h1><div class='bp-body'><data:post.body/></div></article>
</b:loop>
</div>
</b:if>
</b:includable>
</b:widget>
</b:section>

<script type='module'>
//<![CDATA[
/* ============ Satota Shop Firebase Configuration ============ */
const CONFIG = {
  apiKey: "AIzaSyAqIy09_3OKBpDRrzjcFCd0jYBFbD5VZmg",
  authDomain: "satota-shop-317aa.firebaseapp.com",
  databaseURL: "https://satota-shop-317aa-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com",
  projectId: "satota-shop-317aa",
  storageBucket: "satota-shop-317aa.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "948012798516",
  appId: "1:948012798516:web:527cdae816ce2dbe88f061",
  measurementId: "G-P34QJGH8W8"
};
/* ============================================================== */
import {initializeApp} from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.2/firebase-app.js";
import {getAuth,onAuthStateChanged,createUserWithEmailAndPassword,signInWithEmailAndPassword,signOut,updateProfile} from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.2/firebase-auth.js";
import {getFirestore,collection,doc,getDoc,getDocs,setDoc,addDoc,query,where,orderBy,limit,onSnapshot,serverTimestamp,increment,writeBatch} from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.2/firebase-firestore.js";
if(/[?&]m=1/.test(location.search)){location.replace(location.href.replace(/([?&])m=1/,'$1m=0'))}
const app=initializeApp(CONFIG),auth=getAuth(app),db=getFirestore(app);
const $=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s),$$=(s,r=document)=>[...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
const bn=n=>String(n).replace(/\d/g,d=>'০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯'[d]);
const tk=n=>'৳'+bn(Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US'));
const esc=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const PH="data:image/svg+xml;utf8,"+encodeURIComponent("<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 200 200'><rect width='200' height='200' fill='#1b1838'/><text x='100' y='115' font-size='64' text-anchor='middle'>📦</text></svg>");
const LOGO='data:image/png;base64,';
const DEF={siteName:'আমার শপ',tagline:'সেরা পণ্য, সেরা দামে, দ্রুত ডেলিভারি।',announceText:'🎁 নতুন কাস্টমারদের জন্য ১০ পয়েন্ট ফ্রি · ৳৩,০০০+ কেনাকাটায় ডেলিভারি ফ্রি',announceLink:'#/signup',freeDeliveryMin:3000,deliveryFee:80,pointsPerSpend:2000,pointsEarn:100,pointValue:1,welcomePoints:10,whatsapp:'',phone:'',address:'',logo:'',favicon:'',facebook:'',youtube:'',instagram:'',tiktok:'',payMethods:'cod',showTrust:true,trustItems:'🌿|১০০% খাঁটি|সরাসরি উৎস থেকে সংগ্রহ\n💵|ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি|পণ্য হাতে পেয়ে টাকা দিন\n↩️|৭ দিনে ফেরত|সমস্যা হলে সহজ ফেরত\n🚚|দ্রুত ডেলিভারি|সারা দেশে দ্রুত পৌঁছে দিই',flashTitle:'⚡ ফ্ল্যাশ সেল',flashEndsAt:0,categories:[{id:'organic',name:'অর্গানিক',icon:'🌿'},{id:'electronics',name:'ইলেক্ট্রনিক',icon:'🔌'}]};
const S={st:{...DEF},products:[],banners:[],user:null,profile:null,cart:[],ret:'#/',loading:true,wish:[]};
try{S.cart=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cart')||'[]')}catch(e){}
try{S.wish=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wish')||'[]')}catch(e){S.wish=[]}
const saveCart=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('cart',JSON.stringify(S.cart))}catch(e){}};
const fp=p=>{let v=+p.price||0;if(+p.discount>0)v=v*(1-p.discount/100);if(+p.flatDiscount>0)v-=+p.flatDiscount;return Math.max(0,Math.round(v))};
const offp=p=>{const o=+p.price||0;return o>0?Math.round((1-fp(p)/o)*100):0};
const img=p=>(p.images&&p.images[0])||PH;
const pById=id=>S.products.find(p=>p.id===id);
const catOf=id=>(S.st.categories||[]).find(c=>c.id===id);
const toast=(m)=>{const t=$('#toast');t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(toast.t);toast.t=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('on'),2600)};
const normPhone=v=>{v=String(v).replace(/[০-৯]/g,d=>'০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯'.indexOf(d)).replace(/\D/g,'');if(v.startsWith('880'))v=v.slice(2);return v};
const okPhone=v=>/^01[3-9]\d{8}$/.test(v);
const mailOf=ph=>ph+'@user.local';
const first=n=>String(n||'').trim().split(/\s+/)[0]||'কাস্টমার';
const ago=ms=>{const m=Math.max(1,Math.round((Date.now()-ms)/60000));if(m<60)return bn(m)+' মিনিট আগে';const h=Math.round(m/60);if(h<24)return bn(h)+' ঘণ্টা আগে';return bn(Math.round(h/24))+' দিন আগে'};

/* ---------- settings / header ---------- */
function applySettings(){
 const s=S.st;document.title=s.siteName+(s.tagline?' – '+s.tagline:'');
 $('#lgt').textContent=s.siteName;$('#fnm').textContent=s.siteName;$('#ftg').textContent=s.tagline||'';
 const fv=s.favicon||s.logo;
 if(fv){$$('link[rel~="icon"],link[rel="apple-touch-icon"]').forEach(l=>l.remove());['icon','apple-touch-icon'].forEach(r=>{const l=document.createElement('link');l.rel=r;l.href=fv;document.head.appendChild(l)})}
 $$('.lgimg').forEach(i=>i.src=s.logo||LOGO);
 const a=$('#ann');a.innerHTML=esc(s.announceText||'')+(s.announceLink?` <a href="${esc(s.announceLink)}">দেখুন →</a>`:'');a.style.display=s.announceText?'':'none';
 $('#nav').innerHTML=`<a href="#/" data-n="home">🏠 হোম</a>`+(s.categories||[]).map(c=>`<a href="#/c/${esc(c.id)}" data-n="${esc(c.id)}">${esc(c.icon||'')} ${esc(c.name)}</a>`).join('')+`<a href="#/wish" data-n="wish">❤️ পছন্দ</a>`;
 const ph=$('#fph');ph.textContent=s.phone?'📞 '+s.phone:'';ph.href=s.phone?'tel:'+s.phone:'#';
 const wa=$('#fwa');if(s.whatsapp){wa.textContent='💬 WhatsApp';wa.href='https://wa.me/'+normPhone(s.whatsapp).replace(/^0/,'880')}else wa.textContent='';
 $('#fad').textContent=s.address?'📍 '+s.address:'';
 const SO={facebook:['Facebook','#1877f2','<path d="M22 12a10 10 0 1 0-11.56 9.88v-6.99H7.9V12h2.54V9.8c0-2.5 1.49-3.89 3.77-3.89 1.09 0 2.24.2 2.24.2v2.46h-1.26c-1.24 0-1.63.77-1.63 1.56V12h2.78l-.44 2.89h-2.34v6.99A10 10 0 0 0 22 12z"/>'],youtube:['YouTube','#ff0000','<path d="M23.5 6.2a3 3 0 0 0-2.1-2.1C19.5 3.6 12 3.6 12 3.6s-7.5 0-9.4.5A3 3 0 0 0 .5 6.2C0 8.1 0 12 0 12s0 3.9.5 5.8a3 3 0 0 0 2.1 2.1c1.9.5 9.4.5 9.4.5s7.5 0 9.4-.5a3 3 0 0 0 2.1-2.1c.5-1.9.5-5.8.5-5.8s0-3.9-.5-5.8zM9.6 15.6V8.4l6.2 3.6-6.2 3.6z"/>'],instagram:['Instagram','#e1306c','<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="17.5" cy="6.5" r="1.3"/>'],tiktok:['TikTok','#25f4ee','<path d="M16.6 5.8A4.3 4.3 0 0 1 15.5 3h-3.1v12.4a2.6 2.6 0 1 1-2.6-2.6c.3 0 .5 0 .8.1V9.7a5.8 5.8 0 1 0 5 5.7V9a7.4 7.4 0 0 0 4.3 1.4V7.3a4.3 4.3 0 0 1-3.3-1.5z"/>'],whatsapp:['WhatsApp','#25d366','<path d="M12 2a10 10 0 0 0-8.6 15.1L2 22l5-1.3A10 10 0 1 0 12 2zm5.2 14.1c-.2.6-1.2 1.2-1.7 1.2-.4.1-1 .1-1.6-.1-.4-.1-.9-.3-1.5-.6-2.7-1.2-4.4-3.9-4.5-4.1-.1-.2-1.1-1.5-1.1-2.8s.7-2 .9-2.3c.2-.3.5-.3.7-.3h.5c.2 0 .4 0 .6.5l.8 2c.1.2.1.3 0 .5l-.3.4-.4.5c-.1.1-.3.3-.1.6.2.3.7 1.2 1.5 1.9 1 .9 1.9 1.2 2.2 1.3.3.1.4.1.6-.1l.8-1c.2-.3.4-.2.6-.1l1.9.9c.3.1.5.2.5.3.1.2.1.8-.1 1.4z"/>']};
 const LK={facebook:s.facebook,youtube:s.youtube,instagram:s.instagram,tiktok:s.tiktok,whatsapp:s.whatsapp?'https://wa.me/'+normPhone(s.whatsapp).replace(/^0/,'880'):''};
 $('#soc').innerHTML=Object.keys(SO).filter(k=>/^https?:\/\//.test(LK[k]||'')).map(k=>`<a href="${esc(LK[k])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="${SO[k][0]}" style="--c:${SO[k][1]}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="currentColor">${SO[k][2]}</svg></a>`).join('');
 const PAY={cod:['💵 ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি','#16a34a'],bkash:['bKash','#e2136e'],nagad:['Nagad','#f6921e'],rocket:['Rocket','#8c3494']};
 const pm=String(s.payMethods||'').toLowerCase().split(/[,\s]+/).filter(k=>PAY[k]);
 $('#fpay').innerHTML=pm.length?'<small>পেমেন্ট:</small>'+pm.map(k=>`<span style="--c:${PAY[k][1]}">${PAY[k][0]}</span>`).join(''):'';
 $('#fcp').textContent='© '+bn(new Date().getFullYear())+' '+s.siteName+' — সর্বস্বত্ব সংরক্ষিত';
 paintWish();
}
function paintWho(){
 const w=$('#who');
 if(S.user){const n=S.profile?.name||S.user.displayName||'অ্যাকাউন্ট';w.innerHTML=`<a class="me" href="#/account"><b>${esc(n[0])}</b><span>${esc(first(n))}<small>💎 ${bn(S.profile?.points||0)} পয়েন্ট</small></span></a>`}
 else w.innerHTML=`<a class="btn b2" href="#/login">লগইন</a> <a class="btn b1" href="#/signup">সাইন আপ</a>`;
 const n=S.cart.reduce((a,c)=>a+c.qty,0);$('#cn').textContent=bn(n);const bc=$('#bcn');if(bc){bc.textContent=bn(n);bc.style.display=n?'':'none'}
}

/* ---------- cart ---------- */
const cartItems=()=>S.cart.map(c=>({p:pById(c.id),q:c.qty})).filter(x=>x.p);
const cartSub=()=>cartItems().reduce((a,x)=>a+fp(x.p)*x.q,0);
const maxQ=p=>(+p.stock>0?+p.stock:99);
function addCart(id,q=1){const p=pById(id);if(!p)return;if(p.stock!==undefined&&p.stock!==''&&+p.stock<=0)return toast('স্টক শেষ');const c=S.cart.find(x=>x.id===id);if(c)c.qty=Math.min(maxQ(p),c.qty+q);else S.cart.push({id,qty:Math.min(maxQ(p),q)});saveCart();paintWho();paintCart();toast('✅ কার্টে যোগ হয়েছে')}
function paintCart(){
 const items=cartItems(),sub=cartSub(),min=+S.st.freeDeliveryMin||0;
 $('#dbody').innerHTML=items.length?items.map(({p,q})=>`<div class="ci"><img src="${esc(img(p))}" alt=""><div><b>${esc(p.name)}</b><span style="color:var(--gold)">${tk(fp(p))}</span><div style="margin-top:8px"><span class="qty"><button data-q="${p.id}" data-d="-1">−</button><span>${bn(q)}</span><button data-q="${p.id}" data-d="1">+</button></span><button class="rm" data-rm="${p.id}">মুছুন</button></div></div></div>`).join(''):`<div class="empty">কার্ট খালি 🛒</div>`;
 const left=min-sub;
 $('#dfoot').innerHTML=items.length?`<div style="font-size:14px">${left>0?`আর <b style="color:var(--gold)">${tk(left)}</b> কেনাকাটা করলে <b>ডেলিভারি ফ্রি</b> 🚚`:'🎉 অভিনন্দন! আপনার ডেলিভারি ফ্রি'}</div><div class="prog"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,sub/min*100)}%"></i></div><div class="row t"><span>সাবটোটাল</span><span>${tk(sub)}</span></div><a href="#/checkout" class="btn b1" style="width:100%;margin-top:12px" data-close>চেকআউট করুন →</a>`:'';
}
const drawer=o=>{$('#drawer').classList.toggle('on',o);$('#scrim').classList.toggle('on',o);if(o)paintCart()};

/* ---------- components ---------- */
/* ---------- v2 helpers ---------- */
const lowOf=p=>p.stock!==undefined&&p.stock!==''&&+p.stock>0&&+p.stock<=5;
function badgesHTML(p,o,out){
 const isNew=p.createdAt?.seconds&&(Date.now()/1000-p.createdAt.seconds)<7*86400;
 const h=(o>0?`<span class="off">-${bn(o)}%</span>`:'')+(isNew&&!out?'<span class="bdg nw">✨ নতুন</span>':'')+(lowOf(p)?`<span class="bdg lw">🔥 মাত্র ${bn(p.stock)}টি বাকি</span>`:'');
 return h?`<div class="bdgs">${h}</div>`:'';
}
function paintWish(){const n=S.wish.filter(id=>S.loading||pById(id)).length,a=$('#nav [data-n="wish"]');if(a)a.textContent='❤️ পছন্দ'+(n?' ('+bn(n)+')':'')}
function toggleWish(id){
 const i=S.wish.indexOf(id),on=i<0;if(on)S.wish.push(id);else S.wish.splice(i,1);
 try{localStorage.setItem('wish',JSON.stringify(S.wish))}catch(e){}
 $$('[data-wish]').forEach(b=>{if(b.dataset.wish!==id)return;b.classList.toggle('on',on);b.innerHTML=b.dataset.lbl?(on?'❤️ পছন্দের তালিকায় আছে':'🤍 পছন্দের তালিকায় যোগ করুন'):(on?'❤️':'🤍')});
 paintWish();toast(on?'❤️ পছন্দের তালিকায় যোগ হয়েছে':'তালিকা থেকে সরানো হয়েছে');
 if(location.hash.startsWith('#/wish'))route();
}
function copyTxt(t){try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(()=>toast('✅ লিংক কপি হয়েছে'),()=>toast(t))}catch(e){toast(t)}}
const skel=n=>`<div class="grid">${Array(n).fill('<div class="skc"><div class="a"></div><div class="b" style="width:40%"></div><div class="b"></div><div class="b" style="width:70%"></div></div>').join('')}</div>`;
function trustHTML(){
 if(S.st.showTrust===false)return '';
 const l=String(S.st.trustItems||'').split('\n').map(x=>x.split('|')).filter(x=>x.length>=2&&x[1].trim());
 return l.length?`<div class="trust">${l.map(x=>`<div class="trs"><i>${esc(x[0].trim())}</i><div><b>${esc(x[1].trim())}</b>${x[2]?`<span>${esc(x[2].trim())}</span>`:''}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`:'';
}
function flashHTML(){
 const end=+S.st.flashEndsAt||0,live=end>Date.now();
 if(end&&!live)return '';
 const deals=S.products.filter(p=>offp(p)>0).sort((a,b)=>offp(b)-offp(a)).slice(0,10);
 if(!deals.length)return '';
 return `<section class="sec"><div class="flash${live?' on':''}"><div class="${live?'fh':'sh'}"><h2>${esc(live?(S.st.flashTitle||'⚡ ফ্ল্যাশ সেল'):'🔥 ছাড়ের প্রডাক্ট')}</h2>${live?`<span class="fcd" data-end="${end}">⏳ …</span>`:''}</div><div class="hs">${deals.map(card).join('')}</div></div></section>`;
}
const TLS=['pending','confirmed','shipped','delivered'],TLN=['অর্ডার হয়েছে','কনফার্মড','শিপড','ডেলিভারড'],TLI=['📝','✅','🚚','🎁'];
function tlHTML(st){
 if(st==='cancelled')return '<div class="tlx">❌ এই অর্ডারটি বাতিল করা হয়েছে</div>';
 const c=TLS.indexOf(st);
 return `<div class="tl">${TLS.map((k,i)=>`<div class="tls${i<=c?' done':''}${i===c?' cur':''}"><i>${TLI[i]}</i>${TLN[i]}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
function shareHTML(p){
 const url=location.href.split('#')[0]+'#/p/'+p.id,txt=p.name+' — '+tk(fp(p));
 return `<div class="share"><span>🔗 শেয়ার করুন:</span><a class="sh-b wa" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(txt+'\n'+url)}">WhatsApp</a><a class="sh-b fb" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodeURIComponent(url)}">Facebook</a><button type="button" class="sh-b" data-copy="${esc(url)}">📋 লিংক কপি</button></div>`;
}
function relatedHTML(p){
 const l=S.products.filter(x=>x.category===p.category&&x.id!==p.id).slice(0,4);
 return l.length?`<section class="sec"><div class="sh"><h2>আপনার পছন্দ হতে পারে</h2></div><div class="grid">${l.map(card).join('')}</div></section>`:'';
}
function vWish(V){
 const l=S.wish.map(pById).filter(Boolean);
 V.innerHTML=`<section class="sec"><div class="sh"><h2>❤️ পছন্দের তালিকা</h2></div>${(l.length||S.loading)?gridOf(l):'<div class="empty">এখনো কিছু পছন্দ করা হয়নি 🤍<br><a class="btn b1" style="margin-top:14px" href="#/">কেনাকাটা করুন</a></div>'}</section>`;
}
function card(p){
 const o=offp(p),out=p.stock!==undefined&&p.stock!==''&&+p.stock<=0,c=catOf(p.category);
 const w=S.wish.includes(p.id);return `<article class="pc"><button class="heart${w?' on':''}" data-wish="${p.id}" aria-label="পছন্দ">${w?'❤️':'🤍'}</button><a class="pc-i" href="#/p/${p.id}"><img loading="lazy" src="${esc(img(p))}" alt="${esc(p.name)}">${badgesHTML(p,o,out)}${out?'<div class="sold">স্টক শেষ</div>':''}</a><div class="pc-b"><small>${c?esc(c.icon+' '+c.name):''}</small><h3><a href="#/p/${p.id}">${esc(p.name)}</a></h3><div class="pr"><b>${tk(fp(p))}</b>${o>0?`<s>${tk(p.price)}</s>`:''}</div><div class="pc-act"><a class="det" href="#/p/${p.id}">👁️ ডিটেইলস দেখুন</a><button class="add" data-add="${p.id}" ${out?'disabled':''}>🛒 কার্টে যোগ করুন</button></div></div></article>`;
}
const gridOf=l=>S.loading?skel(8):l.length?`<div class="grid">${l.map(card).join('')}</div>`:`<div class="empty">${S.err?'⚠️ ডাটাবেসের সাথে সংযোগ হয়নি — Firebase CONFIG ও রুলস চেক করুন':'এখনো কোনো প্রডাক্ট নেই 📦'}</div>`;
function sorted(l,m){l=[...l];if(m==='lo')l.sort((a,b)=>fp(a)-fp(b));else if(m==='hi')l.sort((a,b)=>fp(b)-fp(a));return l}
function listSec(title,list,cls){return `<section class="sec"><div class="sh"><h2>${title}</h2><select data-sort>${[['new','নতুন আগে'],['lo','দাম: কম → বেশি'],['hi','দাম: বেশি → কম']].map(o=>`<option value="${o[0]}">${o[1]}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div id="lst">${gridOf(list)}</div></section>`}
function bindSort(list){const s=$('[data-sort]');if(s)s.onchange=()=>{$('#lst').innerHTML=gridOf(sorted(list,s.value))}}

const SC={green:['#047857','#10b981'],purple:['#6d28d9','#d946ef'],orange:['#ea580c','#f59e0b'],blue:['#1d4ed8','#06b6d4'],pink:['#be185d','#f472b6'],gold:['#b45309','#fbbf24'],red:['#be123c','#fb7185']};
const mk=t=>esc(t).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,'<b>$1</b>').replace(/\[\[(.+?)\]\]/g,'<span class="pl">$1</span>');
const stripInner=v=>`<i class="si">${esc(v.icon||'')}</i><div class="stx"><div class="s1">${mk(v.text||'')}</div>${v.sub?`<div class="s2">${esc(v.sub)}</div>`:''}</div>${v.btnText?`<span class="sbtn">${esc(v.btnText)}</span>`:''}`;
const stripStyle=v=>{const c=SC[v.color]||SC.green;return `background:linear-gradient(120deg,${c[0]},${c[1]});--tc:${c[0]}`};
function stripsHTML(w){
 const on={home:b=>b.showHome!==false,cat:b=>b.showCat!==false,prod:b=>b.showProd===true}[w];
 return S.banners.filter(b=>b.type==='strip'&&b.active!==false&&on(b)).sort((a,b)=>(a.order||0)-(b.order||0)).map(b=>`<a class="strip" style="${stripStyle(b)}" href="${esc(b.link||'#/')}" ${b.newTab?'target="_blank" rel="noopener"':''}>${stripInner(b)}</a>`).join('');
}
/* ---------- hero ---------- */
function heroHTML(){
 if(S.loading)return '<div id="hero" class="skh"></div>';
 let hs=S.banners.filter(b=>b.type==='hero'&&b.active!==false).sort((a,b)=>(a.order||0)-(b.order||0));
 if(!hs.length)hs=[{badge:'নতুন কালেকশন',title:'*সেরা* পণ্য, সেরা দামে',subtitle:'অর্গানিক থেকে ইলেক্ট্রনিক — সব এক জায়গায়',btnText:'কেনাকাটা শুরু করুন',link:'#/signup',c1:'#1b1140',c2:'#5b2fb5',accent:'#fbbf24',productIds:[]}];
 const n=hs.length;
 const sl=hs.map(b=>{
  let ps=(b.productIds||[]).map(pById).filter(Boolean);
  if(ps.length<3)ps=ps.concat(S.products.filter(p=>!ps.includes(p)));
  ps=ps.slice(0,3);
  const gl=ps.map((p,i)=>`<a class="gl g${i+1}" href="#/p/${p.id}"><img src="${esc(img(p))}" alt=""><span>${esc(p.name)}</span><b>${tk(fp(p))}</b></a>`).join('');
  const t=esc(b.title||'').replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>');
  return `<section class="slide" style="--c1:${esc(b.c1||'#1b1140')};--c2:${esc(b.c2||'#5b2fb5')};--ac:${esc(b.accent||'#fbbf24')}"><div class="hl">${b.badge?`<span class="badge"><i></i>${esc(b.badge)}</span>`:''}<h1>${t}</h1><p>${esc(b.subtitle||'')}</p><a class="cta" href="${esc(b.link||'#/')}">🎓 ${esc(b.btnText||'বিস্তারিত দেখুন')} →</a></div><div class="hv">${gl}<span class="bolt">⚡</span></div></section>`}).join('');
 return `<div id="hero"><div class="htrack">${sl}</div>${n>1?`<button class="har l" data-h="-1">‹</button><button class="har r" data-h="1">›</button>`:''}<div class="dots">${hs.map(()=>'<i></i>').join('')}</div><div class="hc"></div></div>`;
}
function initHero(){
 clearInterval(S.ht);const el=$('#hero');if(!el||!$('.htrack',el))return;
 const tr=$('.htrack',el),n=tr.children.length;let i=0;
 const go=k=>{i=(k+n)%n;tr.style.transform=`translateX(-${i*100}%)`;$$('.dots i',el).forEach((d,j)=>d.classList.toggle('on',j===i));$('.hc',el).textContent=bn(String(i+1).padStart(2,'0'))+' / '+bn(String(n).padStart(2,'0'))};
 go(0);el._go=k=>{go(i+k);reset()};
 $$('.dots i',el).forEach((d,j)=>d.onclick=()=>{go(j);reset()});
 const reset=()=>{clearInterval(S.ht);if(n>1)S.ht=setInterval(()=>go(i+1),5500)};reset();
 let x0=null;el.ontouchstart=e=>x0=e.touches[0].clientX;el.ontouchend=e=>{if(x0===null)return;const d=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-x0;if(Math.abs(d)>50)el._go(d<0?1:-1);x0=null};
}
function promoHTML(){
 const ps=S.banners.filter(b=>b.type==='promo'&&b.active!==false&&(!b.endsAt||b.endsAt>Date.now())).sort((a,b)=>(a.order||0)-(b.order||0));
 if(!ps.length)return '';
 return `<section class="sec"><div class="pbs">${ps.map(b=>`<a class="pb s-${esc(b.style||'flash')}" href="${esc(b.link||'#/')}"><div><small>${esc(b.tag||'অফার')}</small><h3>${esc(b.title||'')}</h3>${b.discountText?`<div class="big">${esc(b.discountText)}</div>`:''}${b.sub?`<p>${esc(b.sub)}</p>`:''}${b.endsAt?`<div class="cd" data-end="${b.endsAt}">⏳ …</div><br>`:''}<span class="go">${esc(b.btnText||'এখনই কিনুন')} →</span></div>${b.image?`<img src="${esc(b.image)}" alt="">`:''}</a>`).join('')}</div></section>`;
}
function tickCD(){clearInterval(S.ct);const run=()=>$$('[data-end]').forEach(e=>{let d=+e.dataset.end-Date.now();if(d<0)d=0;const D=Math.floor(d/864e5),H=Math.floor(d%864e5/36e5),M=Math.floor(d%36e5/6e4),Sx=Math.floor(d%6e4/1e3),z=v=>bn(String(v).padStart(2,'0'));e.textContent=`⏳ ${D?bn(D)+' দিন ':''}${z(H)}:${z(M)}:${z(Sx)}`});run();S.ct=setInterval(run,1000)}

 V.innerHTML=stripsHTML('home')+heroHTML()+trustHTML()+`<div class="tag"><i></i>✦ সব ধরনের পণ্য এক জায়গায়</div><section class="sec" style="margin-top:6px"><div class="sh"><h2>ক্যাটাগরি</h2></div><div class="cats">${cs}</div></section>`+promoHTML()+flashHTML()+listSec('সব প্রডাক্ট',S.products);
 initHero();tickCD();bindSort(S.products);
}

 tickCD();bindSort(l);

function commOf(p){const v=+p.commissionValue||0;if(p.commissionType==='percent')return Math.round(fp(p)*v/100);if(p.commissionType==='fixed')return v;return 0}
function vProd(V,id){
 if(S.loading){V.innerHTML='<div class="pd"><div class="skh" style="height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:26px"></div><div class="skc" style="border:0;background:none"><div class="b" style="width:50%;height:22px;margin-left:0"></div><div class="b" style="width:35%;height:34px;margin-left:0"></div><div class="b" style="margin-left:0"></div><div class="b" style="margin-left:0"></div></div></div>';return}
 const p=pById(id);if(!p){V.innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="margin:40px 0">প্রডাক্ট পাওয়া যায়নি</div>';return}
 const im=(p.images||[]).filter(Boolean).slice(0,4);if(!im.length)im.push(PH);
 const o=offp(p),out=p.stock!==undefined&&p.stock!==''&&+p.stock<=0,cm=commOf(p),c=catOf(p.category);
 let q=1;
 const link=S.profile?.refCode?`${location.origin}/?ref=${S.profile.refCode}#/p/${p.id}`:'';
 V.innerHTML=stripsHTML('prod')+`<div class="pd"><div><div class="gm"><img id="gmn" src="${esc(im[0])}" alt=""></div><div class="gt">${im.map((u,i)=>`<button class="${i?'':'on'}" data-im="${esc(u)}"><img src="${esc(u)}" alt=""></button>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="pi"><small style="color:var(--mu)">${c?esc(c.icon+' '+c.name):''}</small><h1>${esc(p.name)}</h1><div class="pp"><b>${tk(fp(p))}</b>${o>0?`<s>${tk(p.price)}</s><span class="off" style="position:static">-${bn(o)}%</span>`:''}</div><div>${out?'<span class="st st-cancelled">স্টক শেষ</span>':'<span class="st st-delivered">স্টকে আছে</span>'}${lowOf(p)?` <span class="st st-pending">🔥 মাত্র ${bn(p.stock)}টি বাকি</span>`:''}</div><div class="ds">${esc(p.desc||'')}</div><div class="acts"><span class="qty"><button id="qm">−</button><span id="qv">১</span><button id="qp">+</button></span><button class="btn b1" id="ac" ${out?'disabled':''}>🛒 কার্টে যোগ করুন</button><button class="btn b3" id="bn" ${out?'disabled':''}>⚡ এখনই কিনুন</button><button class="btn b2 hbtn${S.wish.includes(p.id)?' on':''}" data-wish="${p.id}" data-lbl="1">${S.wish.includes(p.id)?'❤️ পছন্দের তালিকায় আছে':'🤍 পছন্দের তালিকায় যোগ করুন'}</button></div><div class="perk" style="background:var(--card);border-color:var(--line);color:var(--tx)"><i>🚚</i><div><b>৳${bn(S.st.freeDeliveryMin)}+ কেনাকাটায় ফ্রি ডেলিভারি</b><span>ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি · ডেলিভারি চার্জ ${tk(S.st.deliveryFee)}</span></div></div>${cm>0?`<div class="ref">🤝 <b>রেফার করে আয় করুন:</b> কেউ এই প্রডাক্ট কিনলে এবং ডেলিভারি সম্পন্ন হলে আপনি পাবেন <b>${tk(cm)}</b> কমিশন।${S.user?`<input readonly value="${esc(link)}" onclick="this.select();navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.value);"><small style="color:var(--mu)">ক্লিক করলে লিংক কপি হবে</small>`:`<br><a href="#/login" style="color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline">লগইন করে আপনার রেফার লিংক নিন</a>`}</div>`:''}${shareHTML(p)}</div></div>`+relatedHTML(p);
 $$('[data-im]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{$('#gmn').src=b.dataset.im;$$('[data-im]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b))});
 $('#qm').onclick=()=>{q=Math.max(1,q-1);$('#qv').textContent=bn(q)};$('#qp').onclick=()=>{q=Math.min(maxQ(p),q+1);$('#qv').textContent=bn(q)};
 $('#ac').onclick=()=>addCart(p.id,q);$('#bn').onclick=()=>{addCart(p.id,q);location.hash='#/checkout'};
}
const needLogin=()=>{if(S.user)return false;S.ret=location.hash;toast('আগে লগইন করুন');location.hash='#/login';return true};
function vCheckout(V){
 if(needLogin())return;
 const items=cartItems();
 if(!items.length){V.innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="margin:40px 0">কার্ট খালি 🛒<br><a class="btn b1" style="margin-top:16px" href="#/">কেনাকাটা করুন</a></div>';return}
 const sub=cartSub(),del=sub>=(+S.st.freeDeliveryMin||0)?0:(+S.st.deliveryFee||0),pts=S.profile?.points||0,pv=+S.st.pointValue||1,maxUse=Math.min(pts,Math.floor(sub/pv));
 V.innerHTML=`<div class="two"><form class="box" id="ckf"><h2>📦 ডেলিভারি তথ্য</h2><label class="fl"><span>আপনার নাম</span><input name="name" required value="${esc(S.profile?.name||'')}"></label><label class="fl"><span>মোবাইল নম্বর</span><input name="phone" required value="${esc(S.profile?.phone||'')}" inputmode="tel"></label><label class="fl"><span>সম্পূর্ণ ঠিকানা (এলাকা, জেলা)</span><textarea name="address" rows="3" required></textarea></label><label class="fl"><span>নোট (ঐচ্ছিক)</span><input name="note"></label>${maxUse>0?`<div class="chk"><div style="flex:1">💎 আপনার পয়েন্ট: <b>${bn(pts)}</b> (= ${tk(pts*pv)})<br><small style="color:var(--mu)">কতো পয়েন্ট ব্যবহার করবেন?</small></div><input type="number" id="pu" name="pu" min="0" max="${maxUse}" value="0" style="width:100px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px"></div>`:''}<div class="err" id="ce"></div><button class="btn b1" style="width:100%;padding:14px;font-size:17px">✅ অর্ডার কনফার্ম করুন (ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি)</button></form><div class="box"><h2>🧾 অর্ডার সামারি</h2>${items.map(({p,q})=>`<div class="ci"><img src="${esc(img(p))}" alt=""><div><b>${esc(p.name)}</b>${bn(q)} × ${tk(fp(p))}</div><b>${tk(fp(p)*q)}</b></div>`).join('')}<div class="row"><span>সাবটোটাল</span><span>${tk(sub)}</span></div><div class="row"><span>ডেলিভারি</span><span>${del?tk(del):'<b style="color:var(--ok)">ফ্রি 🎉</b>'}</span></div><div class="row"><span>পয়েন্ট ছাড়</span><span id="pdv">−${tk(0)}</span></div><div class="row t"><span>মোট</span><span id="gt">${tk(sub+del)}</span></div></div></div>`;
 const pu=$('#pu');if(pu)pu.oninput=()=>{let v=Math.max(0,Math.min(maxUse,Math.floor(+pu.value||0)));$('#pdv').textContent='−'+tk(v*pv);$('#gt').textContent=tk(sub+del-v*pv)};
 $('#ckf').onsubmit=async e=>{
  e.preventDefault();const f=e.target,b=f.querySelector('button'),er=$('#ce');er.textContent='';
  const phone=normPhone(f.phone.value);if(!okPhone(phone)){er.textContent='সঠিক মোবাইল নম্বর দিন (০১XXXXXXXXX)';return}
  const use=pu?Math.max(0,Math.min(maxUse,Math.floor(+pu.value||0))):0,disc=use*pv;
  b.disabled=true;b.textContent='অপেক্ষা করুন…';
  try{
   const its=items.map(({p,q})=>({id:p.id,name:p.name,price:fp(p),qty:q,image:img(p)}));
   const bt=writeBatch(db),oref=doc(collection(db,'orders'));
   bt.set(oref,{uid:S.user.uid,name:f.name.value.trim(),phone,address:f.address.value.trim(),note:f.note.value.trim(),items:its,subtotal:sub,delivery:del,pointsUsed:use,pointsDiscount:disc,total:sub+del-disc,status:'pending',payment:'COD',createdAt:serverTimestamp()});
   if(use>0)bt.update(doc(db,'users',S.user.uid),{points:increment(-use)});
   await bt.commit();
   S.cart=[];saveCart();paintWho();location.hash='#/done/'+oref.id.slice(0,6).toUpperCase();
  }catch(x){console.error(x);er.textContent='অর্ডার করা যায়নি, আবার চেষ্টা করুন।';b.disabled=false;b.textContent='✅ অর্ডার কনফার্ম করুন'}
 };
}
function vDone(V,id){V.innerHTML=`<div class="box" style="max-width:560px;margin:50px auto;text-align:center"><div style="font-size:64px">🎉</div><h2 style="font-size:28px">ধন্যবাদ, ${esc(first(S.profile?.name||S.user?.displayName))}!</h2><p style="color:var(--mu);margin:10px 0 20px">আপনার অর্ডার (#${esc(id)}) গ্রহণ করা হয়েছে। আমরা শীঘ্রই কনফার্ম করবো।</p><a class="btn b1" href="#/account">আমার অর্ডার দেখুন</a> <a class="btn b2" href="#/">আরও কিনুন</a></div>`}
async function vAccount(V){
 if(needLogin())return;
 const pr=S.profile||{},pv=+S.st.pointValue||1;
 V.innerHTML=`<div class="sec"><div class="box" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b1d8f,#7c2bb8)"><h2 style="font-size:28px;margin:0">স্বাগতম, ${esc(first(pr.name||S.user.displayName))} 👋</h2><p style="opacity:.85">${esc(pr.phone||'')}</p></div></div><div class="stats"><div class="stat"><small>💎 পয়েন্ট</small><b>${bn(pr.points||0)}</b><small>= ${tk((pr.points||0)*pv)}</small></div><div class="stat"><small>🤝 কমিশন ব্যালেন্স</small><b>${tk(pr.wallet||0)}</b></div><div class="stat"><small>🛍️ মোট কেনাকাটা</small><b>${tk(pr.totalSpent||0)}</b></div><div class="stat"><small>🔗 রেফার কোড</small><b style="font-size:20px">${esc(pr.refCode||'—')}</b></div></div><div class="box" style="margin-bottom:16px"><b>রেফার লিংক:</b><div class="ref" style="margin-top:8px"><input readonly value="${esc(location.origin+'/?ref='+(pr.refCode||''))}" onclick="this.select();navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.value);"></div><small style="color:var(--mu)">যে প্রডাক্টে "রেফার কমিশন" আছে, বন্ধু কিনে ডেলিভারি পেলে কমিশন আপনার ব্যালেন্সে যোগ হবে।</small></div><div class="box"><h2>📦 আমার অর্ডার</h2><div id="ol">লোড হচ্ছে…</div></div><p style="margin:18px 0"><button class="btn b2" id="lo">লগআউট</button></p>`;
 $('#lo').onclick=()=>signOut(auth).then(()=>{location.hash='#/'});
 try{
  const s=await getDocs(query(collection(db,'orders'),where('uid','==',S.user.uid)));
  const os=s.docs.map(d=>({id:d.id,...d.data()})).sort((a,b)=>(b.createdAt?.seconds||0)-(a.createdAt?.seconds||0));
  const L={pending:'অপেক্ষমাণ',confirmed:'কনফার্মড',shipped:'শিপড',delivered:'ডেলিভারড',cancelled:'বাতিল'};
  $('#ol').innerHTML=os.length?os.map(o=>`<div class="ord"><div class="oh"><b>#${o.id.slice(0,6).toUpperCase()}</b><span class="st st-${o.status}">${L[o.status]||o.status}</span></div>${tlHTML(o.status)}<div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mu)">${o.items.map(i=>esc(i.name)+' ×'+bn(i.qty)).join(', ')}</div><div class="row"><span>${o.createdAt?new Date(o.createdAt.seconds*1000).toLocaleDateString('bn-BD'):''}</span><b style="color:var(--gold)">${tk(o.total)}</b></div>${o.rewarded?`<small style="color:var(--ok)">💎 ${bn(o.pointsEarned||0)} পয়েন্ট যোগ হয়েছে</small>`:''}</div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty">এখনো কোনো অর্ডার নেই</div>';
 }catch(e){$('#ol').textContent='অর্ডার লোড করা যায়নি'}
}
function vAuth(V,tab){
 if(S.user){location.hash='#/account';return}
 const top=S.products.slice(0,3);
 V.innerHTML=`<div class="auth"><div class="auth-l"><div class="logo"><img src="${esc(S.st.logo||LOGO)}" alt="">${esc(S.st.siteName)}</div><h2>আপনার পছন্দের সবকিছু, <em>এক জায়গায়</em></h2><p>একাউন্ট খুলুন আর উপভোগ করুন প্রিমিয়াম শপিং অভিজ্ঞতা।</p><div class="perks"><div class="perk"><i>🎁</i><div><b>সাইন আপ করলেই ১০ পয়েন্ট ফ্রি</b><span>প্রতি ১০০ পয়েন্ট = ১০০ টাকা ছাড়</span></div></div><div class="perk"><i>💎</i><div><b>২,০০০ টাকায় ১০০ পয়েন্ট</b><span>প্রতিটি কেনাকাটায় রিওয়ার্ড জমান</span></div></div><div class="perk"><i>🚚</i><div><b>৩,০০০+ টাকায় ফ্রি ডেলিভারি</b><span>ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি সুবিধা</span></div></div><div class="perk"><i>🤝</i><div><b>রেফার করে কমিশন আয়</b><span>বন্ধু কিনলেই আপনার আয়</span></div></div></div></div><div class="auth-r"><div class="acard"><div class="seg"><button data-t="signup" class="${tab==='signup'?'on':''}">✨ সাইন আপ</button><button data-t="login" class="${tab==='login'?'on':''}">🔑 লগইন</button></div><form id="af"></form></div></div></div>`;
 const draw=t=>{
  const su=t==='signup';
  $$('.seg button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.t===t));
  $('#af').innerHTML=`<h3>${su?'নতুন একাউন্ট খুলুন':'আবার স্বাগতম!'}</h3><p>${su?'মাত্র ৩০ সেকেন্ডে একাউন্ট তৈরি করুন':'আপনার নম্বর ও পাসওয়ার্ড দিয়ে লগইন করুন'}</p>${su?`<div class="ip"><i>👤</i><input name="name" placeholder="আপনার নাম" required></div>`:''}<div class="ip"><i>📱</i><input name="phone" placeholder="মোবাইল নম্বর (01XXXXXXXXX)" inputmode="tel" required></div>${su?`<div class="ip"><i>✉️</i><input name="email" type="email" placeholder="ইমেইল (ঐচ্ছিক)"></div>`:''}<div class="ip"><i>🔒</i><input name="pass" type="password" placeholder="পাসওয়ার্ড (কমপক্ষে ৬ অক্ষর)" minlength="6" required><span class="eye" data-eye>👁️</span></div><div class="err" id="ae"></div><button class="btn b1">${su?'🎁 একাউন্ট খুলুন ও ১০ পয়েন্ট নিন':'লগইন করুন →'}</button><div class="sw">${su?'আগে থেকেই একাউন্ট আছে? <a data-sw="login">লগইন করুন</a>':'নতুন? <a data-sw="signup">সাইন আপ করুন</a>'}</div>`;
  $('#af').onsubmit=async e=>{
   e.preventDefault();const f=e.target,b=f.querySelector('.b1'),er=$('#ae'),old=b.innerHTML;er.textContent='';
   const phone=normPhone(f.phone.value);if(!okPhone(phone)){er.textContent='সঠিক মোবাইল নম্বর দিন (যেমন 01712345678)';return}
   b.disabled=true;b.textContent='অপেক্ষা করুন…';
   try{su?await signup(f.name.value.trim(),phone,f.email.value.trim(),f.pass.value):await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth,mailOf(phone),f.pass.value)}
   catch(x){console.error('AUTH ERROR',x);const c=x.code||x.message||'';const M={'email-already':'এই নম্বর দিয়ে আগেই একাউন্ট আছে — লগইন করুন','weak':'পাসওয়ার্ড কমপক্ষে ৬ অক্ষর দিন','invalid-credential':'নম্বর বা পাসওয়ার্ড ভুল','wrong-password':'নম্বর বা পাসওয়ার্ড ভুল','user-not-found':'নম্বর বা পাসওয়ার্ড ভুল','operation-not-allowed':'Firebase এ Email/Password সাইন-ইন চালু করা হয়নি (Authentication → Sign-in method)','permission-denied':'Firestore রুলস Publish করা হয়নি বা মেলেনি (Firestore → Rules)','not-found':'Firestore Database তৈরি করা হয়নি','unavailable':'ডাটাবেসের সাথে সংযোগ হচ্ছে না, ইন্টারনেট/Firestore চেক করুন','network':'ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ নেই','api-key':'Firebase API key ভুল','configuration-not-found':'Firebase Authentication চালু করা হয়নি','too-many':'অনেকবার চেষ্টা করা হয়েছে, কিছুক্ষণ পর আবার চেষ্টা করুন','unauthorized-domain':'এই ডোমেইন Firebase এর Authorized domains এ যোগ করা নেই'};const k=Object.keys(M).find(k=>c.includes(k));er.innerHTML=(k?M[k]:'কিছু একটা সমস্যা হয়েছে')+'<br><small style="opacity:.7">কোড: '+esc(c)+'</small>';b.disabled=false;b.innerHTML=old}
  };
 };
 draw(tab);V.onclick=e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-t],[data-sw]');if(t)draw(t.dataset.t||t.dataset.sw);const ey=e.target.closest('[data-eye]');if(ey){const i=ey.previousElementSibling;i.type=i.type==='password'?'text':'password'}};
}
async function ensureProfile(u){
 if(S.mk===u.uid)return;S.mk=u.uid;
 try{const code=u.uid.slice(0,7).toUpperCase(),bt=writeBatch(db);
  bt.set(doc(db,'users',u.uid),{name:u.displayName||'কাস্টমার',phone:(u.email||'').split('@')[0],email:'',points:10,wallet:0,totalSpent:0,refCode:code,referredBy:'',createdAt:serverTimestamp()});
  bt.set(doc(db,'refCodes',code),{uid:u.uid});await bt.commit();
 }catch(e){S.mk=null;console.warn('profile',e)}
}
async function signup(name,phone,email,pass){
 S.welcome={name,isNew:true};S.signing=true;
 try{return await signup2(name,phone,email,pass)}finally{S.signing=false}
}
async function signup2(name,phone,email,pass){
 let cr;try{cr=await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth,mailOf(phone),pass)}catch(e){S.welcome=null;throw e}
 const u=cr.user;
 try{await updateProfile(u,{displayName:name})}catch(e){}
 const code=u.uid.slice(0,7).toUpperCase();
 let by='';const ref=localStorage.getItem('ref');
 if(ref&&ref!==code){try{const r=await getDoc(doc(db,'refCodes',ref));if(r.exists()&&r.data().uid!==u.uid)by=r.data().uid}catch(e){}}
 const bt=writeBatch(db);
 bt.set(doc(db,'users',u.uid),{name,phone,email,points:10,wallet:0,totalSpent:0,refCode:code,referredBy:by,createdAt:serverTimestamp()});
 bt.set(doc(db,'refCodes',code),{uid:u.uid});
 await bt.commit();
}
function welcome(name,isNew){
 $('#welh').textContent=`স্বাগতম, ${name}!`;$('#welp').textContent=isNew?'🎁 আপনার একাউন্টে ১০ পয়েন্ট বোনাস যোগ হয়েছে। হ্যাপি শপিং!':'আপনাকে আবার দেখে ভালো লাগলো। হ্যাপি শপিং!';
 const w=$('#wel');w.classList.add('on');setTimeout(()=>{w.classList.remove('on');const r=S.ret||'#/';S.ret='#/';location.hash=r.startsWith('#/login')||r.startsWith('#/signup')?'#/':r},2600);
}

/* ---------- router ---------- */
function route(){
 clearInterval(S.ht);clearInterval(S.ct);
 const h=(location.hash||'#/').replace(/^#\/?/,''),pt=h.split('/'),pg=pt[0]||'home';let arg='';try{arg=decodeURIComponent(pt.slice(1).join('/'))}catch(e){}
 const V=$('#view');V.onclick=null;window.scrollTo(0,0);
 const m={wish:vWish,home:vHome,c:vCat,p:vProd,s:vSearch,checkout:vCheckout,done:vDone,account:vAccount,login:v=>vAuth(v,'login'),signup:v=>vAuth(v,'signup')};
 (m[pg]||vHome)(V,arg);
 $$('#nav a').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',pg==='home'?a.dataset.n==='home':((pg==='c'&&a.dataset.n===arg)||(pg==='wish'&&a.dataset.n==='wish'))));
 $$('#bnav a').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.dataset.b===pg||(a.dataset.b==='account'&&(pg==='login'||pg==='signup'))));
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',route);
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 const t=e.target;let x;
 if(x=t.closest('[data-wish]')){e.preventDefault();toggleWish(x.dataset.wish)}
 else if(x=t.closest('[data-copy]'))copyTxt(x.dataset.copy);
 else if(x=t.closest('[data-add]'))addCart(x.dataset.add);
 else if(x=t.closest('[data-q]')){const c=S.cart.find(y=>y.id===x.dataset.q),p=pById(x.dataset.q);if(c){c.qty=Math.max(1,Math.min(maxQ(p),c.qty+(+x.dataset.d)));saveCart();paintCart();paintWho()}}
 else if(x=t.closest('[data-rm]')){S.cart=S.cart.filter(y=>y.id!==x.dataset.rm);saveCart();paintCart();paintWho()}
 else if(x=t.closest('[data-h]'))$('#hero')._go(+x.dataset.h);
 else if(t.closest('[data-close]'))drawer(false);
});
$('#cb').onclick=()=>drawer(true);$('#dx').onclick=$('#scrim').onclick=()=>drawer(false);
$('#sf').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const q=$('#sq').value.trim();if(q)location.hash='#/s/'+encodeURIComponent(q)};

/* ---------- live chat ---------- */
let chatUn=null;
function openChat(){
 const c=$('#chat');if(c.classList.contains('on')){c.classList.remove('on');return}
 if(!S.user){S.ret=location.hash;toast('চ্যাট করতে আগে লগইন করুন');location.hash='#/login';return}
 c.classList.add('on');
 if(!chatUn)chatUn=onSnapshot(query(collection(db,'chats',S.user.uid,'messages'),orderBy('at')),s=>{
  const box=$('#cm');box.innerHTML=s.empty?'<div class="m a">👋 আসসালামু আলাইকুম! কীভাবে সাহায্য করতে পারি?</div>':s.docs.map(d=>{const m=d.data();return `<div class="m ${m.from==='admin'?'a':'u'}">${esc(m.text)}</div>`}).join('');box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight});
}
$('#chatb').onclick=openChat;$('#bchat').onclick=openChat;$('#bcart').onclick=()=>drawer(true);$('#bcat').onclick=()=>{location.hash='#/';setTimeout(()=>{const t=$('.cats');if(t)t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'})},120)};$('#chx').onclick=()=>$('#chat').classList.remove('on');
$('#cf').onsubmit=async e=>{
 e.preventDefault();const i=$('#ci'),t=i.value.trim();if(!t||!S.user)return;i.value='';
 try{await addDoc(collection(db,'chats',S.user.uid,'messages'),{from:'user',text:t,at:serverTimestamp()});
 await setDoc(doc(db,'chats',S.user.uid),{name:S.profile?.name||S.user.displayName||'কাস্টমার',phone:S.profile?.phone||'',lastMsg:t,updatedAt:serverTimestamp(),unreadAdmin:increment(1)},{merge:true})}catch(x){toast('মেসেজ পাঠানো যায়নি')}
};

/* ---------- order popup (শুধু আসল কনফার্মড অর্ডার) ---------- */
async function social(){
 try{
  const s=await getDocs(query(collection(db,'publicOrders'),orderBy('at','desc'),limit(12)));
  const l=s.docs.map(d=>d.data()).filter(x=>x.at);if(!l.length)return;
  let i=0;const p=$('#pop');
  const show=()=>{const o=l[i++%l.length];$('#popt').innerHTML=`<b>${esc(o.name)}</b> অর্ডার করেছেন<br>${esc(o.product)}${o.more>0?` ও আরও ${bn(o.more)}টি`:''}<small>${ago(o.at.seconds*1000)}</small>`;p.classList.add('on');setTimeout(()=>p.classList.remove('on'),5200)};
  setTimeout(function t(){show();setTimeout(t,16000)},7000);
 }catch(e){}
}

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
(function(){try{const r=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('ref');if(r)localStorage.setItem('ref',r.toUpperCase())}catch(e){}})();
let profUn=null;
onAuthStateChanged(auth,u=>{
 const was=S.user;S.user=u;if(profUn){profUn();profUn=null}
 if(u){profUn=onSnapshot(doc(db,'users',u.uid),s=>{S.profile=s.exists()?s.data():null;paintWho();if(!s.exists()&&!S.signing)ensureProfile(u)})}
 else{S.profile=null;if(chatUn){chatUn();chatUn=null}}
 paintWho();
 if(u&&!was&&S.welcome){const w=S.welcome;S.welcome=null;welcome(w.name,w.isNew)}

 if(u&&!was&&/^#\/(login|signup)/.test(location.hash)&&!$('#wel').classList.contains('on')){const n=u.displayName||'';welcome(first(n),false)}
});
applySettings();paintWho();paintCart();route();
(async function(){
 const TO=(p,ms)=>Promise.race([p,new Promise((_,r)=>setTimeout(()=>r(new Error('timeout')),ms))]);
 try{
  const [a,b,c]=await TO(Promise.all([getDoc(doc(db,'settings','main')),getDocs(collection(db,'products')),getDocs(collection(db,'banners'))]),9000);
  if(a.exists())S.st={...DEF,...a.data()};
  S.products=b.docs.map(d=>({id:d.id,...d.data()})).filter(p=>p.active!==false).sort((x,y)=>(y.createdAt?.seconds||0)-(x.createdAt?.seconds||0));
  S.banners=c.docs.map(d=>({id:d.id,...d.data()}));
 }catch(e){console.warn('Firebase:',e);S.err=true}
 S.loading=false;
 applySettings();paintWho();paintCart();
 const pg=(location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/,'').split('/')[0])||'home';
 if(['home','c','p','s','wish','checkout'].includes(pg))route();
 social();
})();
//]]>
</script>
</body>
